create_laplacian_matrix: create the Laplacian matrix of a directed or undirected graph from a dense or sparse adjacency matrix
compute_normalized_laplacian: compute the symmetrically normalized Laplacian of a graph with unit diagonal entries
build_symmetric_laplacian: build a symmetric Laplacian from a non-symmetric adjacency matrix by summing the graph and its transpose conjugate
generate_laplacian_linear_operator: generate a matrix-free LinearOperator for the Laplacian to avoid doubling memory use on large graphs
extract_graph_vertex_degrees: extract vertex degree values from a graph adjacency matrix alongside the Laplacian computation
